reason: A collaboration plugin for parallel agents that supports peer discovery, explicit coordination messaging, delivery receipt checks, and bounded same-workspace context projections without command execution or unrestricted session history access.

summaries.zh: 为并行 Agent 提供同工作区 peer 发现、明确协调消息、传输回执查询和受限上下文读取功能。
summaries.en: Provides parallel agents with same-workspace peer discovery, explicit coordination messaging, delivery receipt checks, and bounded context access.

capabilities: Discover peer agents in the same workspace
Send explicit coordination messages to peer agents
Read bounded, field-whitelisted context projections from authorized same-workspace peer sessions
